elements.content: Saving on autopilot may help you save more.
Payday arrives, the money gets spent,
and whatever is left becomes your savings. Which is often nothing.
A 2001 study followed employees at one large company.
When new hires were enrolled automatically,
Participation was significantly higher than when they had to sign up themselves.
A practical way to try this.
Two: schedule a transfer to a separate account on payday.
Three: set it once, then leave it alone.
This was one study at one company, so results may differ for you.
Try it today: schedule one tiny transfer for your next payday.
Saving on autopilot may help you save more.
